svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 08: People
svg.text: Everyone in the event, who is here, where and playing what, with a role given in one tap; open a person for their sessions, orders and rights.
Use case: an organiser finds a person by nick, sees whether they are here, and makes them Food crew in one tap (1280 px and 390 px)

g.text: Checked in Sat 16:10 at the door

svg.text: A · 1280 px: a table, because people are compared column by column; the person picked opens beside it
B · 390 px: each row a card, the role still one tap

g.text: Tick as many as they do
Run of show: delay and mark done
Orders, menus and the daily record

svg.text: C · roles are presets; several at once
Notes: here, room and game come from a per-person read, never the bus, for organisers only (D5); opt-outs stay hidden (E4).
A role is a preset of rights; single rights stay editable in the person’s panel (U6, U7).
